title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
description: This feature adds a logging middleware to track and record all incoming requests, providing valuable insights for debugging and monitoring purposes. It will log request metadata such as method, path, and response status. This feature is essential for production environments to ensure visibility into system activity
testCases: Test logging for successful GET request
Test logging for failed POST request
acceptance: The logging middleware must log all incoming requests with correct metadata and handle edge cases such as malformed requests
reason: Improved monitoring and debugging capabilities are crucial for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse
